Header.value: Extracted Statement - Is it supported by the evidence?

Text.name: guide
Text.value:
Does the evidence sentence(s) support the statement (subject --predicate--> object)?
2 · 支持 Supported: - the evidence states the same or equivalent semantics as the statement - a rewrite / paraphrase / summary of the statement also counts
1 · 部分支持 Partially supported: - the evidence covers part of the statement but leaves another part unverified (e.g. confirms the subject and relation but not the exact object, or vice versa)
0 · 不支持 Unsupported: - the evidence is unrelated to, or contradicts, the statement - the evidence is too vague or incomplete to verify the statement
Judge only from the shown evidence sentence(s); do not speculate beyond them.
